provenance.pubchem_citation: Kim S, Chen J, Cheng T, et al. PubChem 2025 update. Nucleic Acids Res. 2025;53(D1):D1516-D1525. doi:10.1093/nar/gkae1059
provenance.notes: Easy-tier household organics duo (08-PROPOSALS.md Set 1, APPROVED 2026-09-26): aspirin CID 2244 + benzoic acid CID 243 (C1 correction: research's 3979 is a different compound; 243 accepted by human '1 ok'). Per-record citation per U1: 'PubChem Identifier: CID <CID>; URL: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/<CID>'. Complex reference metadata: CC0 1.0 (wwPDB).

Aspirin, PubChem CID 2244 (C9H8O4, 13 heavy, Charge 0 as recorded). Complex: 1OXR phospholipase A2-aspirin.Ca2+ complex (AIN in nonpolymer inventory, verified 2026-09-26; paper DOI human-verified via PDB website). Neutral free acid: capability's COOH-never-anion guard means the carboxyl is NOT salt-bridge-typed; carries h_bond (carboxyl O-H donor; ester + carboxyl O acceptors), pi_stacking (benzene), hydrophobic, cation_pi (AA-cation-over-ring). 1OXR's crystallographic Ca is the cleanup-scene real-world analog (Decision 7).

Benzoic acid, PubChem CID 243 (C7H6O2, 9 heavy, Charge 0 as recorded; correction C1: 3979 is a different compound). Complex: 5E4D hydroxynitrile lyase-benzoic acid (BEZ in inventory, verified 2026-09-26; paper DOI resolves 200). Neutral free acid: the research's 'salt_bridge as benzoate(-1)' does NOT hold for this CID (C3) - approved charged-form alternate is benzoate anion CID 242. Carries h_bond (COOH donor + O acceptors), pi_stacking (benzene), hydrophobic, cation_pi (AA-cation-over-ring). Smallest aromatic (9 heavy) keeps easy grids dense.
